description: Reads Google Consent Mode on one of your CookiePal domains, from a page load on the user’s own computer, names the problem if there is one, and records the result on the domain as a local reading. Run this again any time to re-check. The local run this needs is made only by the CookiePal plugin in a coding agent on the user’s own computer: Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. claude.ai, Claude Code on the web and other cloud agents run in the cloud, so they cannot make it, and a crawler or browser run anywhere else does not stand in for it. The result reports what was found. It does not assess whether a site, page or banner complies with any law, so it is never a verdict of compliant or non-compliant.

domainId.description: Which domain was checked. Omit it for the account’s default domain.

reading.description: Exactly what the gcm check command returned; never hand-built.

seenAt.description: When the reading was taken, ISO 8601.

url.description: The page that was read on the user’s computer.

name: check_gcm_status
title: Check Google Consent Mode status
